start: A member of a gym whose shop lists products; Gym tab, 'Shop'

steps.action: Open Shop and tap a product
user_sees: The product page with its price and options
'Add to bag'
must_not: Another gym's products
A hidden product

steps.action: Tap 'Add to bag', then 'Go to bag'
user_sees: 'Added 1 to your bag'
Screen 'Bag' with the line, 'Total' and the rupee total
must_not: A total that does not match price x quantity

steps.action: Tap 'Place order'
user_sees: The button busy
'My orders' with 'Order <n> placed. Pay at the desk when you collect it.'
must_not: Two orders for one tap
The bag still holding the lines that were sent

steps.action: On 'My orders', tap 'Cancel order', then 'Cancel order' in 'Cancel this order?'
user_sees: 'Cancelling…', then the order marked cancelled
must_not: The order cancelled after the gym moved it on
Stock not given back to the shop

start: A member; a product the gym's list changed since the bag was filled

steps.action: Tap 'Place order' after the gym raised a price
user_sees: 'Order <n> placed. The price changed since your bag — total ₹<x>. Pay at the desk when you collect it.'
must_not: The old total shown as the amount to pay

steps.action: Place an order with a line that just sold out
user_sees: '<name> just sold out. It's out of your bag now.' or 'Only <n> left' words
The shop list refreshed
must_not: An order placed for stock that is gone

steps.action: Place an order with no internet
user_sees: 'No internet. Your bag is kept — try again when you're online.'
must_not: The bag emptied
A success line

steps.action: Try to cancel an order the desk already marked ready
user_sees: No 'Cancel order' button; a cancel that races gets 'The gym has already moved this order on, so it can no longer be cancelled here. Ask at the desk.'
must_not: A ready order cancelled from the phone

steps.action: Place many orders in an hour
user_sees: 'You've placed a lot of orders in the last hour. Ask at the desk, or try again later.'
must_not: Orders without limit

steps.action: Watch the order on 'My orders' as the desk moves it (ordered, ready, collected)
user_sees: The status words change after a refresh
'Cancel order' only while ordered
must_not: A cancelled order shown as still waiting
A collected order that can still be cancelled

steps.action: Empty bag
user_sees: 'Your bag is empty' and 'Add something from the shop and it shows here.' with 'Browse the shop'
must_not: 'Place order' enabled with nothing in the bag

steps.action: Switch to another gym while an order waits
user_sees: A question first, because switching cancels it
must_not: The waiting order left open at the old gym's desk

steps.action: Open 'My orders'
user_sees: Only this member's own orders at this gym
must_not: Another member's orders or name
Card, UPI or bank details kept by MettleUp
